name: Wailoaloa Beach
note: Beach: 3 km sand beach north of Nadi town, lined with resorts and beach clubs; a swimming and sunset spot.

name: Garden of the Sleeping Giant
note: Garden: former private orchid nursery of Raymond Burr with hilly walking paths and tropical plantings; entry charged.

name: Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple
note: Religious site: large Dravidian-style Hindu temple at the southern end of Nadi; visitors cover up and enter the interior, free to enter.

name: Sabeto Hot Springs and Mud Pool
note: Natural attraction: mud bath and three hot-spring pools in the Sabeto valley near Nadi; mud treatments and massages offered.

name: Skydive Fiji
note: Operator: tandem skydiving company at Martintar, jumps over Nadi; the activity is the jump, the place is the drop zone.

name: Jetboards Fiji
note: Operator: watersports company on Wailoaloa Road offering motorised surfboard and flyboard rides.

name: Pacific Island Air Scenic Flights
note: Operator: helicopter and seaplane scenic flights from Nadi airport over the Nadi basin, Koroyanitu and the islands.

name: Land and Sea Tours Fiji
note: Operator: e-bike, snorkelling and guided tour company based in Nadi; a tour operator, not a place.

name: Nadi Produce Market
note: Market: daily fresh produce market on Hospital Road, Nadi, open Monday to Saturday.

name: Nadi Handicraft Market
note: Market: handicraft and wood-product market at Queens Road and Koroivolu Avenue, open Monday to Saturday.

name: Jack's of Fiji
note: Shop: large handicraft and souvenir store on Queens Road; a shop, not a place to see.

name: Tappoo Department Store Nadi
note: Shop: high-end department store in Nadi selling fashion, perfumes and liquor; a shop.

name: Prouds Nadi
note: Shop: upmarket department store in Nadi selling glassware, electronics and perfume; a shop.

name: Tu's Place
note: Restaurant: traditional Fijian food on Queens Road, Martintar; a restaurant, not a place to see.

name: Ed's Bar
note: Bar: tourist bar on Kennedy Street, Martintar, with a dance area and beer garden; a bar.

name: Big Bula Waterpark
note: Waterpark: inflatable waterpark at Denarau, open daily; a permanent attraction, paid entry.

name: Denarau Golf and Racquet Club
note: Golf course: par 72 18-hole course with water hazards at Denarau; a golf club, with tennis courts.

name: Spa Maya
note: Spa: Ayurvedic spa treatments at Port Denarau Marina; a spa, not a place to see.

name: Flavours of Fiji Cooking Classes
note: Cooking school: daily Fijian cooking classes with market and food tours, Denarau; an operator.

name: Port Denarau
note: Shopping precinct: open-air cluster of souvenir shops, restaurants and a marina at Denarau.

name: Denarau Island
note: Island resort: a private resort island 5 km northwest of Nadi, with golf, marina and resort hotels; a base for the Mamanucas.

name: Viseisei Village
note: Village: the oldest settlement in Fiji, said to be where the first Melanesian canoes beached at nearby Vuda Point; a $5 entry fee applies.

name: Lautoka Botanical Gardens
note: Gardens: tropical plant collection with labelled species in Lautoka, next to a children's park.

name: Lautoka Market
note: Market: large covered produce, spice and kava market beside the Lautoka bus station.

name: Hare Krishna Temple Lautoka
note: Temple: friendly Hare Krishna temple in Lautoka where Sunday lunch visitors are invited to stay.

name: Mount Batilamu
note: Hike: Mount Batilamu trek and Abaca trekking from Lautoka; the peak lies within the Koroyanitu area.

name: Koroyanitu National Heritage Park
note: Park: 35 km2 heritage park around Mount Koroyanitu behind Lautoka and Nadi, with walking trails from Abaca village.

name: Abaca Village
note: Village: access village and visitor centre for Koroyanitu trails, reached by a gravel road from Lautoka; also a guided cultural visit.

name: Savu-i-One Waterfall
note: Waterfall: guided walk to a waterfall on the Koroyanitu trail; from a travel blog only, pending verification.

name: Tunatuna Waterfall
note: Waterfall: self-guided waterfall on the Koroyanitu trail network; from a travel blog only, pending verification.

name: Nausori Highlands
note: Highlands: dry-zone mountain rainforest behind Nadi offering nature walks, hikes and off-road tours.

name: Monasavu Dam
note: Dam: rock-fill dam on the Nanuku River above Monasavu Falls, with the Wailoa Hydro station; visitor access unconfirmed (Naitasiri, central adjacent).

name: Navala Village
note: Village: traditional bure village inland from Ba, where visitors stay in basic homestays; the source is Wikipedia only, a tourism source still needed.

name: Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park
note: National park: Fiji's first national park, 20–60 m parabolic dunes at the Sigatoka River mouth with archaeological sites.

name: Tavuni Hill Fort
note: Historic site: semi-restored 18th-century hill fort near Naroro village, with guides on precolonial history.

name: Biausevu Waterfalls
note: Waterfall: 20 m tiered waterfall reached by a 20-minute rainforest walk near Biausevu, best just after the wet season.

name: Sigatoka River Safari
note: Operator: jet boat ride up the Sigatoka Valley with a visit to a Fijian village; the ride is the activity.

name: Hot Glass Fiji
note: Studio: Fiji's oldest glassblowing studio at Korotogo where visitors can make their own glass piece.

name: Lawaqa Park
note: Stadium: Sigatoka's main rugby ground with 12,000 capacity; local sport venue, not a visitor draw.

name: Natadola Beach
note: Beach: white-sand beach west of Sigatoka, considered one of the best in Fiji, with shade trees and horse riding.

name: Sigatoka Municipal Market
note: Market: produce, seafood and home-baked goods market Monday to Saturday in Sigatoka.

name: Fiji Tattoo's Bula Ink
note: Studio: tattoo parlour in Yadua specialising in Melanesian tattoos for travellers; a shop-type venue.

name: Lawai Pottery Village
note: Village: traditional pottery village in Lawai with demonstrations and a kava and dance ceremony.

name: Sigatoka Hare Krishna Temple
note: Temple: ornate temple built by Hare Krishna devotees, dominating the Sigatoka skyline, open to the public; Wikipedia only.

name: Sigatoka River
note: River: Fiji's major river through the Sigatoka Valley, the basis of jet boat tours; a river, not a visit in itself.

name: Sigatoka
note: Town: the Coral Coast's shopping and market hub at the Sigatoka River mouth, with the sand dunes nearby.

name: Coral Coast
note: Region: the resort coastline east and west of Sigatoka; a region-level place, not a spot.

name: Kula Eco Park
note: Wildlife park: captive breeding of endangered species and environmental education, Pacific Harbour side; paid entry (east of Sigatoka, check central region).

name: Pacific Harbour
note: Town: adventure-activity resort town east of Sigatoka with an arts village (east of Sigatoka, check central region).

name: Arts Village at Pacific Harbour
note: Arts village: South Pacific style shops, restaurants and food store at Pacific Harbour (east of Sigatoka, check central region).

name: Sunset Strip
note: Resort strip: about half a dozen resorts and restaurants just east of Sigatoka at Korotogo, without a single sight of its own.

name: Ratu Udre Udre Tomb
note: Historic site: tomb of 19th-century chief Udre Udre, said to have eaten hundreds of people, near Vaileka.

name: Navatu Rock
note: Landmark: rock beside Kings Road in Vitawa village that looks like a man or a woman depending on the angle; one of Fiji's oldest settlement sites.

name: Rakiraki
note: Town: the Suncoast's main centre on the north coast, base for Nananu-i-Ra boats and the Navatu Rock drive.

name: Ratnam Shopping Centre
note: Shopping centre: local shops in Rakiraki; a shop, not a visit.

name: Nananu-i-Ra
note: Island: small island off Rakiraki reached by boat from Ellington Wharf, with resorts, the One Bay beach and famous dive sites.

name: One Bay Beach
note: Beach: white sand beach on Nananu-i-Ra with a rainforest behind and an ancient village; a sunset and swimming beach.

name: Golden Dream Dive Site
note: Dive site: colourful reef dive at about 20 m off Nananu-i-Ra in the Bligh Waters.

name: Mary's Tag Dive Site
note: Dive site: drift dive along a coral wall dropping past 50 m in the Vatu-i-Ra passage off Nananu-i-Ra.

name: Bligh Waters
note: Waterway: strait between Viti Levu and Vanua Levu famed for soft corals; a diving area around Nananu-i-Ra.

name: Nadi
note: Town: the main gateway city of Fiji beside the international airport, base for Denarau, the Coral Coast and day tours.

name: Lautoka
note: City: Fiji's second city and the sugar city on the west coast, with a market and botanical gardens.

name: Ba
note: Town: the Ba Province town on the northwest coast; the Wikivoyage page is a stub, so no visitor listing confirms a draw.

name: Tavua
note: Town: gold-era town between Ba and Rakiraki beside the Nakauvadra mountains; the Wikipedia article is a disambiguation list, so no visitor listing.

name: Vatukoula
note: Mining town: gold mining settlement 9 km inland from Tavua; a mine town with no visitor listing confirmed.

name: Sabeto
note: Village: hot springs and mud pool village off the Queens Road north of Nadi; the hot springs are listed in its own spot.

name: Vuda Point
note: Headland: point where Melanesian canoes are said to have landed, north of Lautoka near the Vuda Marina; no visitor listing.

name: Lautoka Sugar Mill
note: Industry: sugar mill in Lautoka; no visitor listing, a working factory.

name: Cloud 9 Fiji
note: Floating bar: offshore bar at Denarau from a Trip.com listing only; not fetched, pending verification.

name: Dolphin Bay
note: Bay: named in a Trip.com listing near Tavua/Rakiraki; not fetched, pending verification.
